children: ENFORCEMENT DISPOSAL OF A PROPERTY HELD BY GROUP
ON 18 SEPTEMBER OBTAINED LAND SEARCH REPORT IN RESPECT OF PROPERTY
BECAME AWARE HANG SENG BANK ENFORCED SECURITY OVER PROPERTY BY DISPOSING OF IT ON 5 MARCH
ACCORDING TO LAND SEARCH REPORT, PROPERTY SOLD AT PRICE OF HK$24.4 MILLION
EXPECTED THAT GROUP WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO RECOVER ANY AMOUNT FROM SALE PROCEEDS OF HK$24.4 MILLION
ENFORCEMENT DISPOSAL DISCHARGED MAJORITY PART OF REPAYMENT OBLIGATION UNDER PIL LOAN AND GP LOANS
ENFORCEMENT DISPOSAL HAS NO MATERIAL IMPACT ON GROUP'S BUSINESS OPERATIONS.
